best_model.assumed_error_structure: Gaussian errors on log-scale outcome (OLS on log(vo2_l_min))

normality_jarque_bera.note: Low p-values suggest residuals deviate from normality; with large n, small departures can be detected.

heteroskedasticity_breusch_pagan.note: Low p-values suggest non-constant variance on the log scale.

abs_residual_fitted_correlation.note: Positive correlation between |residual| and fitted values can indicate heteroskedasticity.

influence_outliers.note: Cook's distance is a heuristic for influential observations; investigate points above threshold.
